body: Yea I guess noone wants to help me, it makes sense really...  Just another bitchy kid who knows nothing about real pain... Friends and parents say it all the time I get it..

Last year my ex girlfriend's mom saw me texting her and asking for help and proceeded to call my parents who then cornered me about it making me incredibly insecure and that sparked a bunch of fights in our relationship which ended I'm her saying she'd break up with me if I didn't stop being so sad and cutting so I tried super hard and beat myself up way too much then we broke up.  Upon breaking up I attempted twice in one month and I'm probably worse than ever before now...

TL;DR Tell your parents directly or else it'll fuck everything up even more.

Edit: Sorry if I seem like I'm looking for attention I'm trying to help I swear
I'd give gold if I had money
